gaps.lead: There's no milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: run out of = have none left.

gaps.lead: 'Have you finished the report?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with if/whether + statement word order.

gaps.lead: It's possible that she forgot about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ suitcase that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective becomes such (+a) + adjective + noun: such a heavy suitcase.

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: I would love to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could = regret about ability/possibility.
